turn.user_message: What happens after the two weeks?
turn.context: Processes place, turn 7 (read the numbers and choose: spread, or adjust and try again).

text: After two weeks we read the numbers and choose. If hours from ready to home fell, we spread it. If not, we adjust and try again.
Each new ward starts from the plan step. The software link comes in once two wards run well.
prompts: Where do the automations stand now?
chat.pointer: Step round the loop. At the check, the answer sends you on or back.

blocks.title: Spread only what worked
blocks.deck: One ward at a time, round the same loop. The check after measuring decides where you go next.

gate.question: Did hours from ready to home fall?

sheets.title: Plan
sheets.text: Pick the ward. Name who records the times. Your Head of Operations says yes to the new order.
sheets.entry: What would you need for this step?

sheets.title: Try on one ward
sheets.text: Run the fourteen days. Three quiet days, then the changes in two steps.

sheets.title: Measure
sheets.text: Read the nine windows. Compare the trial days with days 1 to 3.

sheets.title: Adjust
sheets.text: Fix what did not work. Then run one more week on the same ward.

sheets.title: Spread to more wards
sheets.text: Add one or two wards at a time. Link the hospital software once two wards run well.
